prompt:
Product image of one tactical security guard uniform for a near-future corporate site guard, standing in an A-pose. Show the clothing and gear only, as an empty outfit on an invisible mannequin: headless, the collar is an empty opening, nothing inside the outfit.

Pose, the most important thing in this image: a strict A-pose, like a 3D character model sheet. Both arms are perfectly straight and lifted sideways, each one 45 degrees away from the body, so the two arms and the body together make the shape of a wide letter A. The hands are far out to the sides at hip height, well away from the thighs, open with fingers together. Between each arm and the torso there is a big empty triangle of white background that starts right at the armpit and gets wider all the way down to the hand. The upper arms do not touch the vest anywhere, the elbows are far from the waist, and the whole underside of each sleeve from armpit to wrist is visible against white. Legs straight, feet shoulder width apart, a clear gap between the legs all the way up.

{materials}
The grey cloth is clearly greyer and darker than the tan gear, and the tan gear is clearly browner than the cloth.

Smooth clean surfaces like a painted sculpt: plain colour on every part, clean and new with no dirt or wear, matte plastic, smooth cloth with only large soft folds, simple chunky shapes, clean edges between parts.

Camera: straight front view, camera level with the chest, long lens with almost no perspective. The outfit stands upright and symmetrical.

Soft even studio lighting with gentle shading that shows the forms, the whole outfit in frame from collar to boot soles and from hand to hand with margin on all sides, plain white background.
